subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.

The colours of the rainbow seemed to shine through the trianguler prism as the sun hit the object.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'**triangular**'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"trianguler"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**triangular**". (त्रिकोणीय)
 
 
• **Example:** The **triangular **shape of the pyramid was fascinating to the students.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **rainbouw**: This is an incorrect spelling of the word "**rainbow**" (इंद्रधनुष).

 
 
• **Example:** The **rainbow** appeared after the heavy rain.
 
 
 
• **son** (पुत्र): Refers to a male child.
 
 
• **Example:** His **son **graduated from college last year.
 
 
 
• **objact**: This is an incorrect spelling of the word "**object**" (वस्तु).
 
 
• **Example:** The **object **on the table was a beautifully carved statue.
